name: Amolen
summary: Colour- and character-led consumer filament brand founded in 2017 and operating from Los Angeles, California. With roughly four employees it is a brand/import company rather than an extruder; manufacturing is outsourced and almost certainly Chinese, though no factory or OEM has been confirmed.

product_lines.name: PLA Silk (Basic/Dual/Triple/Quad/S-Series/Rainbow/Shiny)
product_lines.notes: Silk-additive PLA; the Dual/Triple/Quad/Rainbow suffixes are multi-colour spool variants of the same chemistry.

product_lines.name: PLA Matte (Basic/Dual/Triple/Rainbow)
product_lines.notes: Matte-finish PLA in single and multi-colour spools.

product_lines.name: PLA Wood
product_lines.notes: PLA with real wood fibre filler.

product_lines.name: PLA Marble
product_lines.notes: PLA with a mineral/stone-look filler. No marble/stone-filled PLA id exists in the catalog, so only the base id is asserted (see gaps).

product_lines.name: PLA Galaxy / PLA Shiny Glitter
product_lines.notes: Glitter/sparkle-particulate PLA; no glitter-PLA id exists (see gaps).

product_lines.name: PLA Metal
product_lines.notes: Genuine metal-powder (iron) filled PLA composite, which is what separates it from the metallic-pigment products of other brands.

product_lines.name: PLA Conductive
product_lines.notes: Carbon-filled electrically conductive PLA composite. Base resin is PLA but the functional category (volume-resistivity-specified conductive compound) has no catalog id, so no id is asserted (see gaps).

product_lines.name: PLA Temp Color Change
product_lines.notes: Thermochromic-pigment PLA; no colour-change id exists in the catalog (see gaps).

product_lines.name: TPU (Basic/Glow/Rainbow/Transparent)
product_lines.notes: Standard flexible TPU; Shore hardness is not published per variant, so no Shore-grade id is asserted.

product_lines.name: PEBA Basic
product_lines.notes: 100% polyether block amide (Pebax-type), NOT TPU or TPE-generic: Shore 90A +/- 1, density ~1.01 g/cm3, tensile ~30 MPa, elongation at break >500%, 78% energy return, elastic to -60 C, melt 175-185 C. No PEBA id exists in the catalog (see gaps).

product_lines.name: ABS
product_lines.notes: Carried from earlier research; ABS did not appear in the current catalog snapshot, so this line may be discontinued and is not included in the trade-name mappings.

additional_notes: Address on file is 8271 Melrose Ave Suite 200, Los Angeles, CA 90046. manufacturing_countries is left empty rather than asserting China: no OEM is disclosed, and the only lead is a Shanghai B2B supplier (Shanghai Maijie Industrial Co., Ltd.) listing 'Amolen Filament products', which reads as a reseller/distributor listing and is explicitly not treated as a manufacturing statement. Amolen's own about page claims materials 'sourced from the United States and made from biodegradable corn starch' for at least some PLA; given the company's size and the absence of any known US extrusion facility this is read as PLA-feedstock marketing language, not evidence of US manufacturing. A 2025 '8 years' anniversary post implies continuous operation since 2017. Instagram, YouTube and X presence was not confirmed. No build plates were found, but this is an unverified negative so makes_plates is left unset.

provenance.conflicts: Amolen's own 'sourced from the United States' PLA claim conflicts with every structural indicator (four employees, no known US extrusion capacity, brand-style operation); this entry treats it as marketing language and asserts no manufacturing country at all. The Shanghai Maijie listing is the sole OEM lead and is judged a distributor listing, so no oem_relationship is recorded.
